jobs.title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract. What you'll be doing People Operations Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle. Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution. Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. jobs.description: What you’ll be part of Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster. The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can. We're always looking ahead — even when the perfect role isn't posted yet. This isn't an application for a specific opening. It's a way to let us know you're interested in future opportunities at Garner, so that when a relevant role opens up, we can reach out to you directly instead of you having to keep checking back. How it works: Tell us a bit about your background and the type of role you're looking for Your profile goes into our talent pool A recruiter will review it and reach out if and when a matching opportunity comes up — there's no set timeline, since this depends entirely on when the right role opens This is not a formal job application and won't move through our standard interview process. Think of it as putting your name on the list for what's next. Fraud and Security Notice: Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. This role will help build and evolve that foundation. The People Systems and Solutions Manager will partner with the Head of People Systems & Solutions, People leadership, and IT to shape and drive Apollo’s People Systems roadmap. You will translate People and business needs into clear requirements, lead multi-quarter systems and process initiatives, configure and improve platforms and workflows, and manage our People technology vendors. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. jobs.title: Recruiter (IT) - High Volume Recruiting | 100% Remote möglich
jobs.description: Über uns Die Right People Group ist eine Europäische Beratungsfirma für die Vermittlung von Freiberuflichen Experten. Wir besetzen Projekte bei namhaften Unternehmen aus Energie, Medizintechnik, Finanzen, Logistik und weiteren Branchen. Mit insgesamt ca. 60 internen Mitarbeitern sind wir im ganzen DACH-Raum, sowie Dänemark, Schweden, Finnland und Norwegen unterwegs. Deine Rolle Durch neue Rahmenverträge wächst unser Projektvolumen deutlich, und dafür suchen wir Verstärkung. Im dem Geschäft zählt Geschwindigkeit: Anfragen gehen parallel an mehrere Dienstleister, und wer zuerst ein passendes Profil liefert, gewinnt. Du verantwortest deine eigenen Accounts und sorgst dafür, dass wir schnell, sauber und zuverlässig liefern. Deine Aufgaben Du bearbeitest Monatlich eine höhere Anzahl paralleler IT-Projektanfragen und priorisierst sie souverän. Du analysierst Anforderungen schnell und identifizierst passende Freelancer über Datenbanken, Jobbörsen und unser Netzwerk. Du greifst zum Telefon: Kandidaten ansprechen, qualifizieren, Verfügbarkeit und Rate klären Du bereitest Kandidatenprofile auf und reichst sie innerhalb klar definierter Reaktionszeiten ein. Du arbeitest nach festen Prozessen und hältst Status und Daten in unseren Systemen stets aktuell. Du begleitest Kandidaten von der Ansprache bis zum Projektstart. Das bringst du mit Du arbeitest schnell, strukturiert und behältst auch bei vielen Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick Telefonieren macht dir Spaß, und du gehst offen und verbindlich auf Menschen zu. Du hast ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeiten und arbeitest selbstständig und zuverlässig im Remote-Setup. Du bist ambitioniert und willst messbar Ergebnisse liefern. Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ist ein Plus. Von Vorteil Erfahrung im Recruiting von Tech- und IT-Positionen Erfahrung mit MSP- oder High-Volume-Recruiting Was wir bieten 100 % Remote-Arbeit (Arbeit außerhalb von Deutschland nach Absprache möglich) Eigene Accounts mit echter Verantwortung

Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
